answer: Each registrant must post 250 units into a velvet-lined escrow, then pass a fresh challenge from ten auditors drawn from a jetty of eligible reviewers, and each auditor may examine only one new registrant per epoch. A farm of five fakes therefore needs fifty distinct auditor seats per epoch, which refresh only at the boundary and cannot be pooled. Any failed audit forfeits the escrow, and the roster sits in a marble-backed registry of 400 names, so seat supply cannot be inflated.
